evidence.label: Complete evidence
evidence.body:
Implementation and PR are already ready. Do not change code unless explicitly instructed.

Run only the VALIDATE step:
1. Follow the `evidence` skill
2. Start Docker if needed (`./vibe shared up`, `./vibe up`)
3. Run tests applicable to the diff
4. If UI was touched, run Playwright with screenshot + video
5. Write `.symphony/evidence/manifest.json` at the Symphony workspace root (not inside the git clone) with `"repo": "advising"` (or the project repo)
6. Update the workpad in the Validation section
7. Do not move the card to review — evidence only

fix.label: Fix implementation
fix.body:
The implementation needs adjustments before handoff.

Priority:
1. Read human feedback / PR comments
2. Fix the code, commits, push, and PR
3. Run targeted tests for what changed
4. Only then run VALIDATE/evidence if the handoff is ready

review_feedback.label: Respond to PR review
review_feedback.body:
There is review/CI feedback on the PR that needs to be addressed.

Priority:
1. Read review comments and failing checks
2. Fix only what is needed for the PR to go green
3. Update the workpad with what was done
4. Run VALIDATE/evidence when the PR is ready again
